channel.title: Computing Foundations :: CS Two Year Refactor
channel.description: All degrees offered by the Department of Computer Science (the Bachelor of Computer Science, the Bachelor of Cybersecurity, and the Bachelor of Artificial Intelligence) share a rigorous 2-year (4-semester) experience grounding students in the foundations of computer science. This sequence of courses draws upon research-backed practices in its design (see chapter 1), where students explore and extend real-world, complex production software systems (see chapter 3) leading to a capstone software development experience at the end of the second year.
